verdict.rationale: Featurebase claims it uses AI to help teams "find the most impactful opportunities" in feedback (docs-7). It also exposes feedback posts and a Reports API backed by its analytics engine (docs-25, docs-28), which a user could wire into their own AI assistant, aided by the llms.txt index (probe-1). There is no evidence of a built-in conversational assistant for querying feedback themes, and nothing on revenue impact; the documented Fibi agent serves customer support, not internal analytics. Missing for 10: a native AI chat or Q&A over feedback themes, revenue or MRR impact attribution for feedback, an MCP or assistant integration for analytics queries, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
